recognize_zh: 骨髓切片中箭頭所指是一顆偏小、核呈單一圓形未分葉（hypolobated / non-lobated）的巨核細胞（megakaryocyte），在造血細胞與脂肪之間，這類小型單核巨核細胞是 del(5q) 骨髓發育不良症候群的特徵線索。
features: Small megakaryocytes with round, non-lobated or hypolobated eccentric nuclei (arrow)
Megakaryocyte cytoplasm moderate, eosinophilic, with smooth contour
Cellular marrow with admixed fat spaces and dilated sinusoids
Trilineage hematopoiesis including erythroid clusters and granulocytic precursors
Scattered hemosiderin-like brown-orange pigment granules in histiocytes
No sheets of blasts appreciated at this magnification
describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy (H&E) shows a cellular marrow with trilineage hematopoiesis intermixed with adipocytes and dilated sinusoids. Megakaryocytes include small forms with round, non-lobated or hypolobated eccentric nuclei (arrow), a dysplastic morphology. Erythroid and granulocytic precursors are present without an obvious increase in blasts at this power, and scattered pigment-laden macrophages are seen. In the appropriate context of macrocytic anemia and a 5q deletion, findings are consistent with myelodysplastic neoplasm with isolated del(5q).

ddx.vs: MPN megakaryocytes are large to giant with hyperlobated (staghorn) or bulbous hyperchromatic nuclei, not small monolobated forms.
Micromegakaryocytes with widely separated nuclear lobes are common in other MDS, and cytogenetics showing isolated del(5q) is required to classify.
Reactive states show normally lobulated megakaryocytes of normal size without clustering of hypolobated forms.
AMKL shows sheets of immature megakaryoblasts with fibrosis and increased blasts, rather than scattered mature hypolobated megakaryocytes.
